blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Erwin Tulfo on Tuesday questioned why he had to personally give P19,000 to a woman seeking to enroll in a caregiving course as she wanted to avail herself of Tesda training. According to the senator, despite thinking that Tesda training should be free, he resorted to giving the woman money as she refused to leave without the financial assistance she asked for. Tulfo raised the issue during the Senate Committee on Finance’s subcommittee hearing on Tesda’s proposed 2027 budget, as he questioned why scholars still have to pay training centers despite government-funded scholarship programs. “Bakit po ’yung […]...
